character.skin_geometry: single voxel-fused surface from overlapping body and muscle volumes

rig.deformation_method: armature modifier with three-nearest-bone inverse-distance blended vertex weights
known_limitations: nearest-bone weighting on the fused torso and limb surface remains heuristic and requires visual validation
no corrective shapes or muscle sliding
digit meshes are separate replaceable geometry with two-segment weights, but bending poses and joint volume preservation remain unvalidated
hidden source anatomy modules are preserved for replacement, but require visibility/export workflow validation
run-away action is procedurally keyed but its gait axes, foot contact, and NLA blending require Blender visual validation
Video6 is a generated single-view clip; arm target keys reproduce visible silhouette and timing but cannot recover hidden depth or calibrated 3D motion
IK pole directions, joint limits, foot plant, and IK/FK behavior require Blender validation
FK/IK snapping, articulated heel/toe roll pivots, and corrective shoulder/elbow/knee shapes remain unfinished
toe and torso reset keys are authored at the Video6 scene boundary but require Blender evaluation to verify the preceding locomotion pose is fully cleared

appendage_system.geometry: 20 separate tapered digit meshes: five fingers per hand and five toes per foot
appendage_system.controls: two deform bones per digit with blended proximal/distal weights
appendage_system.palm_and_foot: remain integrated with the fused body surface
appendage_system.validation: pending Blender execution and pose review

rig.clavicle_chain: clavicle link between spine and upper arm, included in arm IK chain

ik_fk.arm_chain: hand -> forearm -> upper_arm -> clavicle (four-bone IK chain)
ik_fk.controls: hand IK targets and elbow poles; foot IK targets and knee poles; heel/toe pivot reference controls
limitations: pole angles and bend directions need Blender pose validation
FK/IK snapping is not yet implemented
heel and toe pivots are reference controls, not a completed foot-roll mechanism
ik_fk.default_mode: FK to preserve the initial authored rest pose; VIDEO6_POSE_STUDY enables IK for arms and planted feet

locomotion.animation: alternating thigh drive, knee recovery, counter-swinging arms, torso rhythm, wrist/finger grip, toe articulation
locomotion.independence: separate NLA track from the growth-stage custom-property action
locomotion.validation: pending Blender execution, gait review, and ground-contact checks

video6.validation: pending Blender execution and frame-by-frame comparison
video6.description: separate scene sharing the rig and environment objects; independent frame range and camera

lighting.atmosphere: optional low-density volume for A/B comparison

materials.skin: procedural placeholder with tonal noise and subtle bump
materials.cloth: procedural placeholder with fine noise and bump
materials.production_status: not yet calibrated against validated renders

render.camera: growth: original orthographic study camera; run-away: CAM_RunAway perspective; Video6 pose: CAM_Video6 low frontal perspective

optional volume object retained as an independent render variable
character, clothing, environment, and lighting remain separately organized
